findings.title: Backup-code login can bypass password verification
findings.body: Password verification is skipped whenever `credentials.totpCode` is present, but the backup-code branch later authenticates using `credentials.backupCode` without checking the password. A caller can submit an arbitrary TOTP value together with a valid backup code and an incorrect password; the request skips password verification and succeeds via the backup code. Require valid password verification independently of which second-factor credential is used.

findings.title: Backup-code consumption is vulnerable to concurrent replay
findings.body: This reads the backup-code list, validates a code, then writes the modified list in a separate, unconditional update. Two concurrent login requests can both read the original list, both validate the same code, and both succeed before either update takes effect. Make validation and consumption atomic so a backup code can grant access at most once.
